items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: Slam was featured at Traction, he was going to Slam's band, but Lloyd Lambert was really the leader, bass player.

ctx.x: That was my 46-year-old song. Who else was in the band with Slam? With Slam, when I got there it was Lloyd Lambert was the manager, leader of the band. Slam was featured at Traction, he was going to Slam's band, but Lloyd Lambert was really the leader, bass player. And Cotton, Lawrence Cotton was playing piano. And Lloyd played bass, Oscar played drums. Oscar Moore. Yeah. He was with Slam before any of them. And Joe Tillman played tenor sax. Gus played alto, Gus Fontenet. And I played baritone. I was in the band,…
Did it have some like, like, sling his name on the side? Guitar, Slim and his orchestra. And his orchestra.
